name: @sichos-kodesh/pack-builder
description: sk-pack: builds signed .skpack files (plain stored ZIPs of archive objects plus a manifest) from the archive, verifies them, and writes the index.json the download site and the station read.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/archive && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-api
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/archive && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-api
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/archive && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-api
